title: Rippers — Deeper Bonds
description: The campaign's Deeper Bonds system (Aaron Jolliffe playtest) for Project FU: bond tiers (fleeting/solid/eternal), 4-section Bond Clocks on solid bonds, a strength ladder, and invoke = +strength retroactive to the roll just made (via FU's check-push). Extends FU bonds without forking. P1: data model + clocks + tiered caps + invoke wiring.

rippers-deeper-bonds.note: v0.1.2: fixed sheet injection — wired to renderFUStandardActorSheet (the hook FU's ApplicationV2 sheet actually fires; renderActorSheet did NOT fire, so buttons+clocks were missing) with the real 4.16.2 bonds-fieldset selector (legend.bond-add; rows = child div.flexrow indexed by delete button data-bond-index). P1 + tier-CRUD buttons + clocks now render. Extends FU bonds via flags; clock-strength -> bond.bonus. projectfu pinned 4.16.0/4.16.2.
